result.summary: The page is largely coherent, but the horizontal carousels clip content awkwardly at the right edge, promo badge styling is inconsistent, and one promotional label ('-100%') appears to be an incorrect/implausible value. Several smaller styling and content inconsistencies also reduce polish.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card shows a '-100%' discount badge, which implies the entire order is free. This is almost certainly a data or formatting error (e.g. a discount fraction rendered as a percentage).
issues.suggestion: Validate discount values before rendering and cap/verify the range; display the real promo value or hide the badge if the value is invalid.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' card and its title ('Trattoria Piccol…') are cut off hard at the screen edge with no gutter, and the category chip row is likewise clipped mid-chip, making it unclear the rows are horizontally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent horizontal padding/peek so the next item is partially visible in a deliberate way, and ensure titles truncate with an ellipsis inside the card bounds rather than being sliced by the viewport.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards use different treatments: the first has a white filled circle with a dark outline heart, the second has a dark/transparent circle with a white heart. Inconsistent contrast also makes the second harder to see on the light pizza image.
issues.suggestion: Use a single favorite-button style (e.g. white circle with dark heart plus a subtle shadow) across all cards for consistency and reliable contrast.

issues.description: On the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, '€0 delivery' is shown both as an image badge and again in the metadata line, duplicating information.
issues.suggestion: Show the delivery-fee promo in only one place, preferably the badge, and use the metadata line for other attributes.

issues.description: The first 'Fastest near you' thumbnail has a pale grey background while the other thumbnails are dark, so the row looks visually uneven and the white time pill has weak contrast on the light image.
issues.suggestion: Normalize image treatment (e.g. apply a consistent gradient/scrim behind the time pill) so badges remain legible on both light and dark imagery.

issues.description: Cards in 'Fastest near you' show no rating, while 'Popular right now' cards do, making the two sections feel inconsistent in the information they provide.
issues.suggestion: Include rating (or a clear reason for its absence) in both card variants, or standardize the metadata fields shown.

issues.description: Icon-only controls (notification bell with unread dot, heart favorite buttons) have no visible text label, so their purpose and state may not be conveyed to assistive technology.
issues.suggestion: Add accessible labels such as 'Notifications, 1 unread' and 'Add Tokumaru Ramen Bar to favorites', and expose the toggled state.
